newsitem.title: UK: Manchester Utd soars on renewed bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Manchester Utd soars on renewed bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Manchester United soared over 15 percent on Monday on a newspaper report that U.S. marketing agency IMG is considering a takeover bid for the football club.

Manchester Utd shares touched a record 594p in pre-market dealings before settling back to 565p by 0716 GMT, up 51-1/2p on the day. Some 50,186 shares had changed hands. The broader market was slightly lower in quiet trading.
The Express newspaper, citing a "leading City source" said IMG was a likely bidder for Manchester Utd, whose shares have almost tripled in value since the start of the year.

"It's a continuation of recent gains with a few nice comments in the press that (IMG chairman Mark) McCormack is trying to get a bid together. And of course Manchester beat Liverpool," one marketmaker said.
Manchester beat Liverpool 1:0 at the weekend.
